show.description: Alia, desperate to save her mother, is forced into a 6-month contract marriage with the mysterious Karan Malhotra. What begins as a deal soon turns into a tangled journey of care, betrayal, hidden identities, and unexpected love. Will their bond survive the lies and conspiracies—or will this marriage remain just a contract? Watch Now!
